summary.intent: Fix a regression where file sizes and modified dates show '...' on cold start in the CipherBox web app, and add web e2e/smoke coverage so this class of bug is caught.
summary.outcome: Found and fixed three engine/web defects (root focus gap, shared-folder navigation file leg, pre-walk focus false abuse warning), added a cold-start-listing e2e spec and Rust/TS tests, and committed on a fix branch. The final smoke-slice run had not reported yet.

repo: The web sends focus null for the vault root (/files); the engine reads SetFocus{node:None} as 'no folder open', so root file rows were never queued for the file leg. Every Rust test used Some(ROOT), which masked it.
snapshotStore.setFocus dedups against its initial null, so facade.setFocus is never called on a fresh load at /files.
The engine runs commands serially; the web's assertFocus called reportFocus (which triggers a forced manualRefresh) before facade.setFocus, so the forced pass ran with the old focus.
The navigation file leg used to skip rows in a shared folder's own scope; those rows waited for the 30s poll tick. It now runs one file leg per scope using that scope's own seed and floors.

A SetFocus before the first boundary walk read a shared folder under the root seed and raised a false AttributableAbuse. Fixed by running the pass's walk_boundaries inline once, gated by SessionState::boundary_walk_ran.
The sync rung is stamped from the root leg only, so the status bar can show 'synced' while the file leg fails every tick.
Web e2e smoke is every spec not tagged @full; an untagged test joins Web E2E Smoke automatically, which blocks PRs. No prior web e2e spec asserted size or modified cells.

Helpers for cold-start tests: Device.open creates a fresh BrowserContext, FilesPage.cells(name) reads size and modified, freshLogin() mints a login. sharing.ts mint() signs in a new account, so it can't be reused with an existing login.

code.finding: refresh_focus loops queue_unprojected_children over folders_in_view(), which was empty when open_folder was None. The fix adds FocusWindow::folders_in_view_or_root.
setFocus returns early when the node is unchanged. The initial null focus therefore never reaches the engine.
UNRESOLVED = '...' is rendered by projectedSize/projectedDate when child.size or mtime is null.
refresh_focus_on_access holds the on-access folder leg and file leg. It now calls navigation_file_legs per scope and walks boundaries first if none has run.

friction: The assistant's response was stopped once by a safety classifier mid-investigation.
The engine lane first returned an interim 'waiting on test run' result and had to be waited on again.
The first fix changed the behaviour of three existing Rust tests and one capstone test, which had to be adjusted.
Two attempted guards for the pre-walk abuse bug broke six plain-folder cold-start tests before the inline-walk approach was chosen.
The mintLink step in the new shared-folder spec has a 180s timeout, longer than the 120s per-test budget.
The 130s delay seen on staging for the shared-folder rows was not reproduced locally.
open_items: The full local smoke slice run was launched in the background and its result was not seen before the commit.
Whether the false-abuse alternative (not reporting navigation gate rejections as abuse before the walk) needs a trust-reporting and crypto-privacy review; the inline walk was chosen instead.
The public Engine::focus_folders() still excludes the root.
The shared-folder spec's mint timeout (180s) risks exceeding the 120s test timeout, and it assumes the drained probe folder orders the scope-cut publish.
The branch has not been pushed and no PR was opened.
The web-e2e README coverage bullet was added by the assistant, and the walk lane reported that edit as not its own.
The ~130s remaining delay on staging for shared-folder rows is unexplained.
